name: virtual-rows
title: Virtual Rows
description: Windowed rendering for long lists and tables on TanStack Virtual, in document flow with gap rows, the focused row kept rendered, and find in page through hidden=until-found stubs.
docs: `useVirtualRows({ count, virtualize, estimateSize, getKey })` virtualizes past 200 rows with `virtualize="auto"`. Put `anchor` on the `ul` or `tbody`; it scrolls with the nearest scrolling ancestor, or the window. Render `segments`: rows, and gaps (`aria-hidden`) that hold the space of the rows between, so a table keeps `tbody > tr` and a list `ul > li`. Give each row `data-index` and `ref={measureElement}`. `pin(index)` keeps the focused row rendered when scrolled away; `renderNow(index)` renders one at once, for an agent's action. `VirtualFindStubs` writes the text of the rows that aren't rendered as `hidden="until-found"` elements, so find in page reaches them and scrolls the real row in.
